shots.line: Your Life as CJ from GTA San Andreas
shots.scene: Establishing wide of Los Santos at dusk: palms and low roofs silhouetted, sun bleeding down the street; title card glowing in caps over the skyline

shots.line: Imagine being born in Los Santos, where surviving is harder than staying out of trouble.
shots.scene: Wide street: a kid in an oversized green cap walks the centre line; behind him two adult silhouettes argue on a porch, a police car's red-blue wash slides across the houses

shots.line: You're Carl Johnson, better known as CJ.
shots.scene: Medium: CJ steps out of the sunset into frame, green cap lit from behind, rim light along his shoulder; he looks up at the camera and the name 'CJ' snaps in beside his head

shots.notes: no figure — object insert only, tasteful
shots.scene: Insert, top-down on wet asphalt: a red-orange bandana and a fallen cap lying beside a chalk outline; rain rings spread; the camera is very close and everything else is blurred away
Wide: CJ with a duffel bag over his shoulder walks toward his mother's house at the end of the street; a taxi pulls away behind him, tail lights shrinking

shots.line: only to find your gang falling apart
shots.scene: Porch: a boarded window, faded green spray-paint, two plain-ink figures slumped on the steps doing nothing; CJ stands in front of them, small, and the camera slowly pulls back

shots.line: and your neighbourhood taken over by rival gangs.
shots.scene: Over-the-shoulder: CJ's blurred shoulder in the foreground; across the street a purple crowd walks the block in a loose line, one of them tagging over the green wall; slow push

shots.notes: signature bullet-time; FX.drops + FX.rings, camera barely creeps
shots.scene: FREEZE FRAME: CJ mid-dive behind a car, dust and droplets hanging in the air, bullet streaks frozen as thin bright lines; a '100x' badge in the corner, cool tint, slow ring expanding from his head

shots.notes: insert-led, faces mostly out of frame
shots.scene: Casino interior: green felt under a low chandelier, chip stacks and a duffel bag being swept across the table; CJ's hand enters frame, the dealer's silhouette behind, slot machines glowing behind

shots.notes: hero left facing right, cop right facing left
shots.scene: Alley two-shot, side view: the cop in sunglasses leans in, arm out, smug; CJ stands his ground, chin up, and slides a folder of photographs across the crate between them; siren light washes the wall

shots.line: You go from a broke street gangster
shots.scene: Data card, dark: a wallet falling open with nothing in it, a coin rolling away; a counter reads $0 and the number refuses to move; CJ's silhouette stands behind the card
Night street of shopfronts: windows light up one after another down the block, each with a small gold 'OWNED' tag snapping on; a counter in the corner climbs fast
Blueprint map of San Andreas on navy grid: light-blue district outlines, green zones flooding outward one region at a time, gold labels ticking 'TERRITORY 1... 12'

shots.line: and even buying an abandoned airfield.
shots.scene: Airfield at golden hour: cracked runway leading to the horizon, hangar and windsock on the left, a prop plane parked small in the distance; CJ walks out toward it, tiny against the sun

shots.line: And somehow, you end up becoming one of the richest gangsters in San Andreas.
shots.notes: climax; slow push-in, bloom on skyline
shots.scene: Rooftop at night: CJ in a suit but still wearing the green cap, back to us, looking over the lit city below; money stacks and a case on the parapet, a counter racing to a seven-figure total

shots.line: All because you came home for your mother's funeral.
shots.notes: the only shot with the sun in front of CJ
shots.scene: Cemetery at dusk: CJ stands small at a headstone, the sun directly behind it so his figure is a silhouette; a bunch of flowers at the base, dust in the light, very slow pull-out
End screen over a darkened dusk skyline: serif italic question 'Would you have come home?', a comment bubble and a subscribe pill; the whole cast lined up small at the bottom
